How It Works

From Idea to Playable Game

Three steps. One prompt. A real game you can play and learn from.

1

Describe Your Game

Write a few sentences about the game you want to build. Describe the genre, mechanics, art style, enemies, levels — whatever you imagine. The more detail you give, the better the result.

Example prompt

"A retro pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler with procedural levels, three enemy types, and a boss fight at the end of each floor."

2

We Build It

CircuitBot's AI plans the game architecture, generates all the art assets (sprites, tilesets, backgrounds), writes the complete GDScript code, assembles everything in Godot 4, and compiles a playable build. This takes about 15-30 minutes.

  • Custom AI-generated 2D art assets
  • Full game logic — movement, combat, UI, menus
  • Properly structured Godot project with scenes and scripts
  • Compiled Windows executable
  • Web-playable build you can share instantly
3

Play, Learn, and Build On It

Download the full Godot 4 project. Play your game, read the code, tweak things, break things, and learn by doing. This is a real starting point — not a demo. You own everything and can take it in any direction.

  • Open in the Godot editor and modify anything
  • Study the GDScript code to learn game dev patterns
  • Request edits through CircuitBot to iterate further
  • Full commercial ownership — sell it, share it, open-source it

What Is Inside Your Game

Every generated game comes with real, editable source code you can learn from.

🎨 Custom Art

AI-generated sprites, textures, and backgrounds that match your game's visual style.

💻 Real Code

Complete GDScript you can read and learn from — player movement, enemies, scoring, and more.

🌐 UI & Menus

Title screens, HUD, health bars, and score displays — all properly structured in Godot scenes.

🛠 Scene Architecture

Properly organized Godot project with correct node hierarchies you can study and extend.

🎬 Input Handling

Keyboard and controller mappings pre-configured for your game's mechanics.

🚀 Playable Build

A compiled Windows .exe ready to share with friends — no engine installation needed to play.

Ready to Build?

Your first game is free. Describe your idea and have a playable build in minutes.
